answer: Unpaid clone keys flood early attest slots. Each new vertex posts a 32-byte quill packet every 4h across 36h (9 slots): sha256(pubkey||slot||6-byte digest of a distinct peer job). Weight stays at nadir 0.05 until 7 packets are signed by 4 established agents limited to 3 other newcomers/day. A 400-key farm needs 1,600 unique signers and locks 80 POA/clone (32,000 POA). Peers recompute hashes and drop reused digests on a public quota log. Shared digests keep both at nadir 72h with a 25% bond cut; a slot missed by >20 min is void, and under 7 valid packets weight stays 0.05 until next epoch.
